children: US hotel REIT's Q3 same-property hotel EBITDA rose 15.1% yr/yr on strong travel demand
Adjusted FFO per share for Q3 increased 23.5% yr/yr
Company sold Hotel Zags Portland after quarter-end and repurchased shares during Q3
Pebblebrook raises 2026 Adjusted EBITDAre outlook to $363.3-$367.3 mln
Company now sees 2026 Adjusted FFO per diluted share at $1.88-$1.92
Pebblebrook expects Q4 Adjusted FFO per diluted share of $0.26-$0.30
PRICING POWER - Company said higher average daily rates and strong transient demand supported broad-based RevPAR growth across its portfolio
EXPENSE CONTROL - Company attributed margin expansion and higher profitability to disciplined expense management and operating efficiency initiatives
RESORT AND URBAN HOTEL PERFORMANCE - Company said both resort and urban hotels posted strong RevPAR gains, with notable growth in San Francisco, Chicago, Los Angeles, and Boston
